edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Jazz on the Alley's penultimate Thursday brings The Odyssey Band to Ram Cat Alley, then Walhalla's Oktoberfest takes over Sertoma Field for three full days — German food, carnival rides, and fireworks. Chattooga Belle Farm runs its first-ever Fall Harvest Festival Saturday morning, and Jocassee Valley Brewing has a full four-day run: a trail talk, two live sets, and an amber ale release.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley: The Odyssey Band
events.body: One of two Thursdays left in this year's run. The Happy Hour Showcase opens the street, then The Odyssey Band takes the main set.
events.note: Free · Happy Hour Showcase 5:30–6:30pm, The Odyssey Band 7–9pm · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca

events.title: Walhalla Oktoberfest opens its three-day run
events.body: Running since 1979, Walhalla's Oktoberfest takes over Sertoma Field with German food, live music, craft vendors, and carnival rides through the weekend. Fireworks are part of the festival, though the exact night wasn't posted when we checked.
events.note: $5 admission (ages 6+, under 6 free) · carnival wristbands $30/day Fri–Sat, $25 Sun · Sertoma Field, 272 Tulip Dr, Walhalla · Fri–Sun

events.title: Jocassee Valley Brewing: Rachel Van Slyke
events.body: One Armed Smoker parks out front for the day, then Rachel Van Slyke plays an evening set.
events.note: Free · Music at 6:30pm · open 9am–9pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

events.title: Chattooga Belle Farm's first Fall Harvest Festival
events.body: A new one this year: local vendors, hayrides, apples and apple cider donuts, live music, and Belle's Bistro's Choc's BBQ food truck on-site for the morning.

events.title: Brewery music carries on under Oktoberfest
events.body: If Oktoberfest and the harvest festival aren't your Saturday night, both breweries run their usual live-music set: Jocassee Valley Brewing has Freddie Vanderford playing Piedmont blues with Majoe's Filipino food out front, and Keowee Brewing runs its regular Friday–Saturday set (check their calendar for who's playing — it wasn't posted by name when we checked).
events.note: Free · Jocassee Valley Brewing music 6:30pm · Keowee Brewing — see calendar for set time

events.title: Jocassee Valley Brewing: Singer-Songwriter Showcase
events.body: Rick Malec hosts a singer-songwriter showcase to close the weekend, with the Farm to Fire Fermentery food truck out front for the afternoon.
events.note: Free · Music at 4pm · open 12–7pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

plan.title: Catch Jazz on the Alley, then plan your Oktoberfest run
plan.body: The Odyssey Band plays Ram Cat Alley at 7pm — grab dinner downtown first, since Walhalla's three-day Oktoberfest and all the brewery music start stacking up Friday.
plan.label: Find a spot to eat & drink →

plan.title: Launch early — Saturday's the busy one
plan.body: Between Oktoberfest, the Chattooga Belle harvest festival, and both breweries' music nights, Saturday has the most pulling at it. Get on the water in the morning before any of it starts.
plan.label: Find a ramp →

plan.title: A swim, then let Jocassee Valley close it out
plan.body: Nothing else dated during the day — pick a swim spot, check today's lake level, and save Rick Malec's showcase for late afternoon.
